title: Arrival Language Lock
description: A four-image reference-dependent package that locks the core spatial language of luxury hotel lobby arrival system before controlled viewpoint and mood variations.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the canonical spatial language for Hotel Lobby. Images 02-04 depend on that reference and vary viewpoint, mood, or functional emphasis while preserving the same authored identity.
